description: Get a download link for one copy of an employee's W-2, for a tax year that has ended. Returns download_url, a link on nannykeeper.com that works for 15 minutes: give it to the user and tell them to open it in their browser to download the PDF. This tool never returns the PDF itself, and you must not open the link yourself. The family generates the W-2 in the dashboard first (Taxes, then W-2s); until then this answers w2_not_generated with a link to that page, and this tool never generates one. For a household other than the key's own, pass its employer_id.

copy.description: Optional. Which copy of the W-2. Defaults to B. Each PDF says on its face who that copy is for.

employer_id.description: Optional. Leave it out to use the household your API key belongs to. Pass it only when one account manages several households; list_employees returns it.

tax_year.description: A tax year that has ended, for example 2025.

name: get_w2
